Remark
[uniqueness and differentiable dependence] ↗ thm:dc-ch3-3-7 1. ch3:3.8From item 5 and the minimizing property of geodesics, any two points $q_1,q_2\in W$ are joined by a unique minimizing geodesic $\gamma $ of length $<\delta $; moreover $\gamma $ depends differentiably on $(q_1,q_2)$: there is a unique $v\in T_{q_1}M$ with $F^{-1}(q_1,q_2)=(q_1,v)$, depending differentiably on $(q_1,q_2)$, with $\gamma '(0)=v$. Such a $W$ is a totally normal neighborhood of $p\in M$.
